narrative.intro: Southwest Valley Constructors obligated $2.5B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors won 7 awards in the current fiscal year to date and the average award size is $355M. The Department of Homeland Security accounts for $2.5B of obligations in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense accounts for $11.9M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market for Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date with $2.5B in obligations. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction is a secondary market for Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date with $11.9M in obligations. Southwest Valley Constructors reported $78.4M in obligations in FY21. Current-year totals for Southwest Valley Constructors are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity only. The FY2026 obligations for Southwest Valley Constructors are highly concentrated in building construction and in a single buying agency.

sections.heading: Who are the biggest federal buyers of Southwest Valley Constructors?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security is the biggest buyer, obligating $2.5B in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense is a secondary buyer, obligating $11.9M in FY2026 to date. Buying activity for Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date is concentrated in those two agencies.

sections.heading: What services and markets capture Southwest Valley Constructors' federal obligations?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest market, capturing $2.5B in FY2026 to date. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction captures $11.9M in FY2026 to date. The FY2026 obligations for Southwest Valley Constructors show a concentration in building construction work.

faq.q: How much does Southwest Valley Constructors make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors obligated $2.5B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors won 7 awards in the current fiscal year to date and the average award size is $355M.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Southwest Valley Constructors?
faq.a: The Department of Homeland Security obligates $2.5B to Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligates $11.9M to Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Southwest Valley Constructors sell to the government?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors sells building and infrastructure construction services to the government. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $2.5B of Southwest Valley Constructors' obligations in FY2026 to date and Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $11.9M in FY2026 to date.
